crossRefs.note: “There is no one like God, Jeshurun, who rides on the heavens for your help, in his excellency on the skies.
You are happy, Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by Yahweh, the shield of your help, the sword of your…
then you will delight yourself in Yahweh, and I will make you to ride on the high places of the earth, and I will feed…
The Lord Yahweh says: ‘Because the enemy has said against you, “Aha!” and, “The ancient high places are ours in…
when my steps were washed with butter, and the rock poured out streams of oil for me,
But he would have also fed them with the finest of the wheat. I will satisfy you with honey out of the rock.”
They didn’t thirst when he led them through the deserts. He caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them. He also…
I will also strike my hands together, and I will cause my wrath to rest. I, Yahweh, have spoken it.”

translations.web: He made him ride on the high places of the earth. He ate the increase of the field. He caused him to suck honey out of the rock, oil out of the flinty rock;
translations.bsb: He made him ride on the heights of the land and fed him the produce of the field. He nourished him with honey from the rock and oil from the flinty crag,
translations.kjv: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, that he might eat the increase of the fields; and he made him to suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the flinty rock;
translations.asv: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, And he did eat the increase of the field; And he made him to suck honey out of the rock, And oil out of the flinty rock;
